name: Gildan Activewear Inc.
note: Canadian apparel manufacturer listed on the Toronto and New York stock exchanges (GIL). Acquired HanesBrands on 1 December 2025; in July 2026 it agreed to sell the HanesBrands Australia business (which includes Bonds) to BBFIT Investments Pte Ltd, an entity of BB Retail Capital, a deal expected to close in the second half of 2026.
